title: Gauge-Dressed Complex Geometry and T-duality in Heterotic String Theories
summary: We study T-duality of $(p,q)$-hermitian geometries in backgrounds with non-Abelian gauge fields $A$ in heterotic string theories. We introduce a gauge-dressed complex geometry characterized by a shifted metric $\bar{g} = g + \frac{1}{2} \mathrm{Tr}(A^2)$, the closed 2-form $ω$ and a quasi complex structure satisfying $\bar{J}^2 < 0$, but not necessarily $\bar{J}^2 = -1$. Utilizing the positive and negative chirality half generalized complex-like structures constructed by $(\bar{g}, \bar{J})$, we derive a heterotic Buscher-like rule for geometric quantities.
